about: Vibratory finisher, self-made in Blender (sources/tumbler/build_tumbler.py) from makers' photos of round-bowl vibratory finishers (CRW Finishing, Raytech and Kramer class, found by image search) and the record (30 in, 1.5 cu ft bowl): the black base drum on its foot ring with the motor's vent slots and the timer box (knob, start and stop), the black rubber skirt over the springs, the blue steel bowl with its rolled rim, the red polyurethane lining up its walls and round the centre column, the blue dome and its hold-down nut, a bed of ceramic triangle media with a few aluminium parts showing, the discharge gate with its lever, and the drain hose. Where the placeholder (planner.placeholders.vibratory_finisher) has its boxes.
reviewed: 2026-11-06: modelled against maker photos; look sheets and three.js before/after checked

source.made: self-made in Blender from public dimensions and photos; build script and .blend beside it

tumbler_blue.about: the finisher's blue steel bowl, centre dome and discharge gate

tumbler_red.about: the bowl's red cast polyurethane lining; the stop button

tumbler_black.about: the base drum and its foot ring

double_sided_why: self-made closed solids, normals checked outward when built (jig.orient), hidden faces culled: single-sided saves fill rate
sources_used: the record (1.5 cu ft, 30 in bowl, 0.75 hp) and its placeholder's boxes
makers' photos of round-bowl vibratory finishers (crwfinishing.com, Raytech, Kramer listings) found by image search

unsure.what: generic: no maker; blue bowl and black base as the placeholder had them, the lining red as on most round bowls
